name: Lindsey Graham
stance: Backs a dedicated federal regulator for AI and the largest tech platforms — the Warren-Graham commission model — to support safe AI development without stifling it.

statements.text: With Sens. Warren, Bennet, and Welch, urged the Majority Leader to back a new agency to regulate digital platforms and AI; with Warren he introduced the Digital Consumer Protection Commission Act to establish such a commission.
Today's challenge calls for a dedicated and nimble agency that is able to keep measured pace with the speed of innovation, supporting safe development without stifling it
